durability.submission_unique: global client_submission_id UUID unique; reuse by another actor/event refused403/409 without exposing receipt
durability.batch_unique: global batch_id UUID unique; same actor/event/request fingerprint replays original receipt
durability.fingerprint: raw-json-sortkeys-v1: SHA256 UTF8 of version + newline + canonical RAW request/application JSON for valid and invalid applications, sorted object keys, preserved array order, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false; omitted/null/empty distinct. No raw payload stored/logged.
durability.transaction: Event row then fresh actor FOR UPDATE (matches legacy lock order); preflight every global ID; accepted effects plus all item/batch receipts atomic commit; global-ID collisions403/409 roll back whole batch; unexpected error also whole rollback, fresh receipt readback before any retry.
durability.cross_device_identity: another submission ID with same event/identity produces duplicate with no business insert; conflicting claimed participant identity is rejected; do not reveal other actor registration ID
durability.client_unknown: unknown is only client uncertainty after transport loss; query GET before resend with same IDs; never convert unknown to rejected or automatically create new IDs
durability.existing_policy: accepted item creates offline pending only; existing total quota/waitlist/Approve policy unchanged; full means approved total already reaches total capacity, rejected before new pending creation
durability.replay_policy: fresh auth and same actor required on every POST/GET; already committed same-ID replay returns historical outcome even if event later closes/fills; new items recheck current event/identity/schema
durability.auth: Invalid/expired JWT or deleted user401; current DB role changed403. No JWT revocation ledger claim. Re-read actor under row lock on write/replay and GET.
durability.receipt_status: registration_status_at_recording is immutable historical status. Replays never change accepted to duplicate. Current lifecycle comes from authorized fresh registration GET.
durability.identity_reuse: Only unclaimed participant previously registered offline by the same actor, with exact seven core identity fields, may be reused across events. Other actor or online-user identity claims rejected; no participant mutation.
durability.collision: Global ID collisions across actors/events produce controlled403/409; nested savepoints isolate per-item identity races; unexpected failures roll back whole batch. Native collision tests required.
durability.concurrent_abort: PostgreSQL40P01 deadlock or40001 serialization abort rolls back whole losing batch and returns409; no automatic business retry. Opposite submission/identity ordering native40P01 cases tested; reconcile original identifiers.
durability.transaction_conflict: PostgreSQL40P01 deadlock/40001 serialization abort rolls back losing batch and returns controlled409; no automatic business retry. Client first reconciles original IDs.
